run_find_litellm_type_hints: run the script to find all litellm type hints in a directory recursively
run_main: run the main function to scan the litellm directory for type hints
find_litellm_type_hints: find all type hints containing litellm in Python files under a given directory
scan_file_for_type_hints: scan a single Python file for litellm type hints using AST parsing
check_is_litellm_type_hint: check if an AST node represents a type hint containing litellm
